verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks collects W-4 equivalent filing/withholding info during employee enrollment (docs-7) and general onboarding timelines/process exist (docs-17, docs-28), but there's no explicit documentation of a unified self-serve flow that also collects I-9 and bank/direct-deposit details before day one. missing for 10: explicit mention of I-9 collection, bank/direct deposit setup as part of onboarding flow, and confirmation that all three (W-4, I-9, bank) are bundled into one self-serve pre-day-one flow.
